annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ½ Correct formulae of reactants and products, but hydrogen atoms are not balanced (6 H on LHS vs 4 H on RHS; requires 3H₂).

teacherNote: Marked against: (i) Correct balanced chemical equation: 3BaCl₂ + Al₂(SO₄)₃ → 3BaSO₄ + 2AlCl₃ (1); (ii) Correct balanced chemical equation: 2Al + 3H₂O → Al₂O₃ + 3H₂ (1). You identified the correct chemical formulae for all reactants and products, and balanced the first reaction accurately. In the second equation, recount your hydrogen atoms: 3H₂O contains 6 hydrogen atoms, requiring 3H₂ as the product.
